subject: Space activation and API-seed access handshake
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@crescentpay.com>, Crescent Pay Platform <platform@crescentpay.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Space activation and API-seed access handshake

Alex / Platform team —

Thanks for the time today. Per our onboarding run-through, this thread will capture the decisions we need to get your first Redwood "space" (project namespace) live and seeded with API credentials so your engineers can start integrating. High-level agenda below; please confirm items 2–4 so we can proceed with the seed this week: 

1) Spaces we will create (names proposed)
   - crescentpay-prod
   - crescentpay-staging
   - crescentpay-dev

2) Initial admin list (who gets Organization Admin + invitation) — I need your list of emails that should be admins.

3) API seed approach — options: a) Redwood creates a service account in your prod/staging and hands you a single long-lived secret to rotate, b) we create scoped API tokens per project and seed into your secrets manager, or c) you create the service account and we seed keys via an authenticated link. We recommend option (b) for least blast radius.

4) Role mapping — suggested minimal roles: Admin, ProjectEditor (for engineers), BillingViewer (for procurement), ReadOnly (for auditors). I attached a short matrix to map your internal teams against these roles.

Action requested: reply with the admin list and tell us whether you want Redwood to create the spaces and do the API-seed (we can, with an initial onboarding window) or if you prefer to create them and we just seed into the provided IDs.

Attachments: crescent_onboarding_checklist.pdf, initial-project-map.csv

Thanks — I’ll schedule a 30-minute seed window once we confirm.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Customer Success Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0189

From: Alex Martinez <alex@crescentpay.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Crescent Pay Platform <platform@crescentpay.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Nov 2028 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Space activation and API-seed access handshake

Thanks Jonas — quick answers inline.

2) Admin list (prod + staging):
   - alex@crescentpay.com (Platform Lead)
   - sarah.kim@crescentpay.com (SRE)

3) We'd prefer option (b) — scoped API tokens per project, seeded into our Vault (Hashi). If Redwood can push the initial tokens into a temporary secure link we can pull them into Vault that'd be ideal.

4) Role mapping: that mapping looks good. One nuance: our analytics team needs ProjectEditor in staging only.

Also: do you have a recommended rotation cadence for the seeded tokens? We are ISO 27001 aligned and prefer 90 days by default but open to shorter for service accounts.

We are fine with Redwood creating the spaces and doing the initial seed so long as the tokens are handed to us for ingestion into Vault and you mark them as short-lived.

— Alex
Alex Martinez
Platform Engineering Manager | Crescent Pay
alex@crescentpay.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@crescentpay.com>, Crescent Pay Platform <platform@crescentpay.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Nov 2028 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Space activation and API-seed access handshake

Great — thanks for the quick reply, Alex. Summary of decisions and the proposed execution plan: 

Decisions
- Redwood will create the three spaces: crescentpay-dev / crescentpay-staging / crescentpay-prod.
- Initial admins: alex@crescentpay.com, sarah.kim@crescentpay.com (we'll invite both as Org Admins).
- API-seed strategy: Redwood will create scoped tokens for each project and deliver them via a one-time secure link you can use to ingest into Vault. Tokens will be issued with a 30-day TTL and we will provide a recommended rotation playbook to move to your 90-day cadence after validation.
- Role nuance: analytics team will get ProjectEditor in staging only; we will reflect that in the invite matrix.

Execution plan (timeline)
- Wed 29 Nov, 10:00–10:30 PST: Redwood ops window — create spaces and seed staging tokens (canary).
- Wed 29 Nov, 14:00–14:30 PST: Prod seed window (only after canary success).

What we need from Crescent Pay before the Wed window
- Confirm that the two admin emails above are correct (reply ok).
- Confirm the Vault ingestion path where you want the temporary link to be posted (e.g., vault.crescentpay.com:8200/secret/redwood/initial). If you prefer, we can provide a signed artifact for manual ingestion.

Attachments included: redwood-api-seed-README.md (steps for ingesting tokens into common vaults and sample rotation scripts).

Security notes
- Seed tokens are single-purpose, scoped to the named space and permissions.
- We will tag each created credential in our audit logs and provide the audit snapshot after the seed.

If everything here looks good, please reply with a single-line approval and the Vault path and we will proceed with Wed’s canary.

— Jonas

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@crescentpay.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Nov 2028 16:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Space activation and API-seed access handshake — final confirmations and invites

Alex / team — finalizing the record after today’s canary run. 

Confirmed items:
- Admin invites sent: alex@crescentpay.com, sarah.kim@crescentpay.com (they should see Redwood invite emails in ~5 minutes).
- Spaces created: crescentpay-dev, crescentpay-staging, crescentpay-prod (verified).
- Canary seed executed for staging at 10:05 PST — tokens delivered via temporary secure link that Alex confirmed pulling into Vault.
- Prod seed completed at 14:12 PST after canary verification.

Invite & role mapping (final)
- crescentpay-prod: alex@crescentpay.com (Org Admin), sarah.kim@crescentpay.com (Org Admin), billing@crescentpay.com (BillingViewer)
- crescentpay-staging: analytics@crescentpay.com (ProjectEditor), eng-team@crescentpay.com (ProjectEditor)
- crescentpay-dev: eng-team@crescentpay.com (ProjectEditor)

Next steps / housekeeping
- I attached the onboarding checklist and a CSV with the final project map.
- Jonas will deliver the audit snapshot (log export) for the seed actions by EOD tomorrow.
- We recommend a token rotation runbook: initial rotation at 30 days (Redwood-led assist), transition to your 90-day cadence thereafter.

If anything needs adjusting we can reopen, otherwise I’ll mark the onboarding ticket as "seed-complete" in HubSpot and share the audit artifact.

Thanks all — welcome aboard.

— Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

Attachment stubs: crescent_onboarding_checklist.pdf, initial-project-map.csv, redwood-api-seed-README.md
